description: Structured evidence and remediation intent extracted from driver triage call.

driver_verified_safe_location.description: Whether driver confirmed truck is stopped in a safe location (e.g., shoulder, rest stop)
driver_verified_safe_location.title: Driver Verified Safe Location

reefer_engine_running.description: Whether the diesel reefer refrigeration unit is actively running/humming
reefer_engine_running.title: Reefer Engine Running

air_bulkhead_obstructed.description: Whether freight or pallets are blocking the front return air bulkhead
air_bulkhead_obstructed.title: Air Bulkhead Obstructed

cargo_sweating_detected.description: Whether visible moisture, sweating, or condensation was observed on cargo packaging
cargo_sweating_detected.title: Cargo Sweating Detected

driver_reported_alarm_code.description: Active microprocessor alarm code displayed on unit controller (e.g., 'ALARM 18')
driver_reported_alarm_code.title: Driver Reported Alarm Code

driver_hos_minutes_remaining.description: Driver-reported remaining driving hours in minutes under FMCSA 49 CFR Part 395
driver_hos_minutes_remaining.title: Driver Hos Minutes Remaining

selected_option.description: Remediation option agreed upon with driver during voice triage
selected_option.title: Selected Option

emergency_reported.description: Whether driver reported an active physical accident, cargo fire, or road hazard
emergency_reported.title: Emergency Reported
